name: versus-panel
title: Versus Panel
description: Two halves of a comparison split by a 3px ink diagonal, with a VS burst at the crossing. Side by side from a container width of 36rem, the halves stack below it and the split becomes a zig from left to right with the VS on it (container queries, no viewport breakpoints). Exactly two VersusSide children; highlight gives one side the ink flat with paper text (the recommended offer). Each side is a named region. Gestures: case (outer frame), flat (highlight), burst (VS mark).
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/versus-panel". Give each VersusSide an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby on a heading). Put kit Buttons inside the sides; use variant="outline" on the highlighted side, since its background is ink.
